text:
Maya Lin: Heads up — spotty 500s on lumen/aurora-lite /compose in eu-west2, seeing KV cache misses spike. Anyone know the quick logquery to grab these?

Jamal Ortiz: Use Logsearch, something like this to filter by org/model/route/status:
```
service: inference
org:"lumen"
model:"aurora-lite"
route:"/compose"
region:"eu-west2
status_code:>=500
| stats count() by status_code, kv_cache_hit
```

Priya Nair: If you want just misses add `kv_cache_hit:false` and check `kv_cache.load_time_ms:>20` to catch slow loads.

Maya Lin: Can someone save that as a shared saved-search? I'll need it for the RFC and postmortem if this gets noisy.

Sam (SRE): I can. Name ok: `lumen-aurora-eu-compose-5xx-kvmiss` ?

Maya Lin: Perfect.

Sam (SRE): ops-bot: create-saved-search --name "lumen-aurora-eu-compose-5xx-kvmiss" --query "service:inference AND org:\"lumen\" AND model:\"aurora-lite\" AND route:\"/compose\" AND region:\"eu-west2\" AND status_code:>=500 AND kv_cache_hit:false"

ops-bot: Saved search created: lumen-aurora-eu-compose-5xx-kvmiss — https://logs.redwood.com/saved/lumen-aurora-eu-compose-5xx-kvmiss :white_check_mark:

Jamal Ortiz: Also flagging alert tuning: `high-5xx-by-route` is too coarse for some EU routes. Recommend a per-route override for aurora-lite in eu-west2 to 0.25% over 10m.

Priya Nair: Filed INF-4012 to add the override and link the saved search. I'll update the runbook link: https://wiki.redwood.com/runbooks/alerts/high-5xx-by-route

Maya Lin: Great, where should I look for traces to correlate user requests?

Jamal Ortiz: Traces UI -> filter `service:inference`, `trace.tag.org:lumen`, `trace.tag.model:aurora-lite`, group by `route` and inspect traces with `http.status_code >= 500`.

Maya Lin: Will attach trace links to INF-4012. Ping here if alert thresholds change.

Sam (SRE): Ack — I'll post back when the override is live and include the alert config diff.
